claim_kind: Real pinned SDK client code against synthetic stdio processes; no real Codex backend/provider, no native CVG implementation.

identity.dependencies: dependency-proposal.json; acquired raw artifacts + extracted file tree must be bound before execution
identity.config_driver_observer: New concrete files must have bytes/SHA256 and first/last checks; no wildcard code identity or null receipt admitted.
identity.loaded_libraries: Before admission record executable ELF/interpreter/stdlib/native shared-object roots and OS/libc identity; after run check actual mapped files. Unexpected writable/unknown code root invalidates observation.
identity.qualifier_mapping: Do not encode a source tree digest as LOCAL_BINARY. Existing qualifier LOCAL_BINARY remains the actual executable SHA; SDK/deps/config/driver/observer are separately bound input identities. Before any comparison bind through supported schema or prepare a new reviewed contract; this HOW grants no receipt/schema extension.

python.path_policy: Driver inserts fixed /profile/sdk-python then /profile/python-deps into sys.path; remaining stdlib roots enumerated in admission. No PYTHONPATH/user site/sitecustomize; no source patch or monkeypatch.
python.API_boundary: CodexClient real request/router/reader/model code; AsyncCodexClient ordinary start cancellation and real goal cancel helper are identified internal SDK boundaries, not claims of full public API coverage.
python.fixtures: Concrete RPC values in cases.json are produced by separate synthetic peer behind a stdio adapter. Both peer and adapter reopen named observer FIFOs after exec; no SDK patch, inherited-FD assumption or genuine Codex metadata claim.
python.uncovered: Default binary resolution/distributed runtime/proxy, actual checkout schema command, full Pydantic API, full async goal startup daemon/cancel and stream state machine remain required future profiles.
python.case_instrumentation: SDKPY07 only: threading.setprofile installed before executor workers, exact code-identity return hook for _TurnSubscription.close. Observation-only, no state/return/argument rewriting; hash-bound collector and known-bad missing-event rejection required. This scope is instrumented client behavior; timing/performance of an uninstrumented client remains open.

typescript.compiler: Lock-selected TypeScript5.9.2; root AST parser6.0.3 is not this toolchain.
typescript.build_contract: Use actual TS5.9.2 transpileModule once on each of the ten byte-exact source files, ES2022/ESNext, remove type-only imports as compiler normally does; report diagnostics and emitted tree hashes; no upstream source edits, no custom AST transformation, no bundler/minifier.
typescript.loader_contract: Exact allowlist only: resolve relative extensionless SDK specifiers to same-directory manifest-listed emitted .js; pass node: builtins; deny all other URL/package/absolute imports. Bind loader code/config and selftests before execution. Loader has no fetch or transformSource hook. Driver/tool imports are separately prebound file URLs; never arbitrary input paths.
typescript.fixture_executable: Node shebang stdio adapter launches the separately identified synthetic Node peer; see transport-topology.json. Both reopen their own named FIFOs; adapter preserves byte/exit behavior subject to declared observation and signal constraints.
typescript.limits: This custom source-transpile/loader profile is not the upstream tsup bundle, declaration generation, typecheck or distributed npm artifact. All those remain OPEN.

stop_policy: No SDK import until admission and driver/observer qualification pass. No auto retry of timeout/ambiguous/failed case; preserve partial raw bytes and status. A changed driver or compiler requires new source identity and explicit bounded replan; no relabeling old observations.
transport_topology: transport-topology.json; selected process graphs, argv, FIFO mounts/framing, relays, barriers, exit and capture-completeness contract
